summary.zh-CN: Dropout 在训练的每次前向中，按概率随机把一部分神经元输出置零，让模型不能长期依赖固定的共适应路径；[[term:inference|推理时]]关闭随机屏蔽，使用完整网络。
summary.en-US: During each training forward pass, Dropout randomly sets some neuron outputs to zero with a given probability so the model cannot depend on a fixed co-adaptation path. During [[term:inference|inference]], random masking is disabled and the complete network is used.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 训练时不断抽取不同的随机子网络，推理时恢复完整网络；被屏蔽的是本次激活，不是永久删除参数。
coreConclusion.en-US: Training repeatedly samples different random subnetworks; inference restores the complete network. Masked activations are temporary, not permanently deleted parameters.
